Population increased in Derbyshire

The estimated population of Derbyshire in 2024 was 822,377 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Derbyshire increased by 3.2%.

Age profile of Derbyshire

The average (median) age fell to 45.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Derbyshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
By age category, Derbyshire's population of 822,377 usual residents was made up of:

  • 137,322 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.7%)
  • 499,035 people aged 16 to 64 years, (60.7%)
  • 186,020 people aged 65 years and over, (22.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Derbyshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Derbyshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Derbyshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Derbyshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 2,042 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 6,953 births and 8,995 deaths in Derbyshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 8,626 (1.1%). There were 38,587 people entering the area and 29,961 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Derbyshire's population of 2,158 (0.3%) as a result of 3,270 people entering the area and 1,112 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Derbyshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Derbyshire in mid-2023 is 813,633.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,207 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 977 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 2,184 people.
